description: Returns a free vocabulary set from the SpeakBase public library (about 2,300 sets written and checked by teachers) for a language pair, optionally filtered by CEFR level and topic, with up to 25 cards (word or phrase and its meaning). Includes a link to study the set with audio and games on SpeakBase, and a link to speak with Kate about it.

native_language.description: The language the meanings should be in (two-letter code). If omitted, English meanings are preferred.

topic.description: A word to match in the set title or tags, for example food, travel, phrasal verbs, past simple.

name: get_vocabulary_set
title: Get a vocabulary set
